spec.title: Dependency-Track Internals
spec.description: Dependency-Track API server internals: durable execution engine, JVM, database and caches.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Time since the API server started.

spec.title: Heap used
spec.description: Used JVM heap as a share of the maximum heap.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU usage of the API server process (share of the available CPUs).

spec.title: Engine leader
spec.description: Whether this instance holds the durable execution engine leadership (it schedules tasks).

spec.title: Polls skipped
spec.description: Task worker polls skipped because of backpressure in the selected time range: workers are saturated.

spec.expr:
clamp_min(
  sum by () (dt_dex_engine_task_worker_poll_skipped_backpressure_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"})
  - (sum by () (dt_dex_engine_task_worker_poll_skipped_backpressure_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"} offset $__range) or sum by () (dt_dex_engine_task_worker_poll_skipped_backpressure_total{job="dependency-track-api-server"}) * 0),
0)

spec.title: Open circuit breakers
spec.description: Circuit breakers currently open or half-open.

spec.title: Worker utilization
spec.description: Share of each task worker's concurrency slots in use.

spec.title: Task processing time (p95)
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time to process a task, by queue.

spec.title: Activity tasks scheduled
spec.description: Activity tasks scheduled per second, by activity.

spec.title: Task scheduling latency (p95)
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time between a task becoming due and being scheduled, by queue.

spec.title: Event buffer flush time (p95)
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time to flush each engine event buffer to the database.

spec.title: Buffered events
spec.description: Events waiting in each engine buffer.

spec.title: JVM heap
spec.description: Heap memory used, committed and maximum.

spec.title: GC pause time
spec.description: Share of time the JVM spends paused for garbage collection, by collector.

spec.title: CPU usage
spec.description: CPU usage of the API server process and of the whole system it runs on.

spec.title: Database connections
spec.description: HikariCP connection pool: active, idle and pending connections, and the pool size.

spec.title: Connection acquire time
spec.description: Average time to obtain a connection from the pool.

spec.title: Slowest queries (p95)
spec.description: The 10 database queries with the highest 95th percentile latency.

spec.title: Cache hit ratio
spec.description: Share of cache lookups served from the cache, for caches in use.

spec.title: Outbound HTTP latency (p95)
spec.description: 95th percentile of the time for calls to external systems, by method.
